**Upgrade the existing sandbox login when reseeding.**

When the sandbox login already exists, the script skips the `createUser` call and never sets `full_access`. A database seeded by the previous call keeps that login without full access. The seed header describes the script as idempotent, so rerunning it on an existing database is a supported workflow. The login then fails the `FULL_ACCESS` privilege check. A fresh database avoids this, so the impact is limited to local sandboxes.

<details>
<summary>🐛 Suggested fix</summary>
<dl>
<dd>

```diff
--- "a/apps/api/scripts/seed.ts"
+++ "b/apps/api/scripts/seed.ts"
@@ -18,7 +18,8 @@
 const [email, password] = [process.env.NL_EMAIL, process.env.NL_PASSWORD]
 if (email && password) {
   const [u] = await db.execute(sql`SELECT 1 FROM users WHERE email = ${email.toLowerCase()}`)
   if (!u) await createUser(db, email, password, true) // seed login is the sandbox owner
+  else await db.execute(sql`UPDATE users SET full_access = true WHERE email = ${email.toLowerCase()}`)
 }
 const [n] = await db.execute(sql`SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM events) AS events, (SELECT count(*) FROM journals) AS journals, (SELECT count(*) FROM customers) AS customers`)
 console.log('seeded', profile, n)
```

</dd>
